label: Naive CD8 T cells
description: Cluster 0 is dominated by M69, a naive T-cell program (TCF7, LEF1, CCR7, SELL, IL7R, LTB, SATB1) with CD8A and CD8B signal, present in ~98% of cells at 17% share and 63x enrichment, pointing to naive CD8 T cells. Supporting pan-T factors M61 and M32 are present, and top genes (NELL2, TCF7, CD8A, LEF1, CCR7, SATB1, THEMIS) agree. Most remaining metagenes (M0, M24, M18, M38, M51, M60) are diffuse housekeeping/background factors with no lineage, and the cytotoxic genes are absent, so no significant contamination is evident.
cell_types: Naive CD8 T cells, Naive T cells
metagene_label: Naive CD8 T cell markers + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Naive T cells
description: Cluster 1 is a large naive T-cell population. Its identity rests on several naive T metagenes (M52, M64, M66, M56, M75) and pan-T metagenes (M61, M42, M32), with top genes TRBC1, TRAC, TCF7, CCR7, LEF1, SATB1 and BCL11B. M66 adds a naive CD4-leaning signal, but CD8A and GZMK are absent from the top genes, so CD4 vs CD8 cannot be resolved cleanly and the label stays at naive T cells. Diffuse background metagenes (M0, M24, M78, M83) and low-specificity factors carry modest shares with no lineage meaning. No meaningful contaminating lineage was found.
cell_types: Naive T cells, Naive CD4 T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + Naive T cell markers

label: Naive CD4 T cells (quiescent)
description: Cluster 2 is a large, quiescent naive T-cell population. Naive T identity is supported by several metagenes (M52 naive T markers, M66 naive CD4 T cells, M75, M64, M56, M61 pan-T, M19 TCR/CD3, M67 T lineage ETS1/LEF1), and the top genes (TCF7, IL7R, LEF1, CCR7, SATB1, BCL11B, TRAT1, ITK) match. M66 and M79 point toward CD4 naive T cells, with no cytotoxic CD8 (CD8A, GZMK) or FOXP3 signal. Most of the signal is diffuse background (M0, M24, M9 glucocorticoid/stress program) rather than contamination from another lineage, and no foreign lineage metagene is enriched.
cell_types: Naive CD4 T cells, Naive T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + Naive T cell markers

label: Naive CD4 T cells (IEG-low)
description: Cluster 3 is a large naive T-cell population, with naive CD4-leaning identity. Naive T-cell metagenes dominate the enriched factors (M52 TCF7/LEF1/CCR7/SELL, M66 naive CD4 with IL7R/CD4/TRAT1/ITK, M64, M56, M75, M79), and top genes TCF7, LEF1, CCR7, BCL11B, SATB1, ITPKB, MAL and TRABD2A confirm a quiescent naive T identity. CD8 and cytotoxic genes are absent. Diffuse background (M0, M24) and an IEG stress program (M21, EGR1/FOSB/JUN) are minor and do not define the cluster. No meaningful contamination from other lineages was detected.
cell_types: Naive CD4 T cells, Naive T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + Naive T cell markers

label: Naive CD4 T cells (interferon-stimulated)
description: Cluster of naive T cells, supported by a summed set of naive T metagenes (M66 naive CD4, M64, M52, M56, M61 pan-T, M79 CD4-leaning) and top genes TCF7, LEF1, CCR7. CD4 versus CD8 is not resolved, though M66 and M79 lean CD4. A strong interferon-stimulated gene program (M57, fold 11.6x, IFI44/IFI6/OAS3/ISG15; M99 IFN-gamma) is enriched and present in a subset of cells (about 7%), which qualifies the identity rather than indicating contamination. The diffuse background metagenes (M0, M20, M24, M71) carry little identity information.
cell_types: Naive CD4 T cells, Naive T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + Naive CD4 T cells
refine_reason: Composition is naive CD4 (M66 4.2%) with an interferon program (M57 3.9%); the base identity should match the other naive CD4 clusters, with the interferon state as the qualifier.

label: Class-switched memory B cells
description: Cluster 5 is a B-lineage cluster. M50 (class-switched/memory B cell program, MS4A1, CD79A, BANK1, IGHA1, IGHG1, TNFRSF13B) carries 20% of counts in 91% of cells, and the top genes (MS4A1, CD79A/B, BANK1, BLK, TNFRSF13C, POU2AF1, IRF8, IGHA1, IGHG1, TNFRSF13B) are coherently B-lineage with >100x enrichment for several isotype/TACI genes. M2 (naive B markers IGHM, IGHD, FCER2, TCL1A) and M53 (B add-on, IGHG3/FCRL5) add B-cell support, so the cluster leans toward switched/memory B cells with some naive-like content. The remaining metagenes (M0, M20, M4, M28, M45, M62, M73, M58, M82) are diffuse background, stress/IEG or mitochondrial factors with no contaminating lineage, so there is no meaningful foreign signal.
cell_types: Memory B cells, Class-switched B cells, Naive B cells
metagene_label: Class-switched memory B cells + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Naive B cells
description: Cluster 6 is a naive B cell population: M2 (naive B cell markers, 30.4% share, 59.4x fold, present in all cells) carries the canonical B lineage signature (IGHM, IGHD, FCER2, TCL1A, MS4A1, CD79A, PAX5, FCRL1, CD22), and the top genes are dominated by these same B-lineage transcripts. M53 (B cell add-on with FCRL5/IGHG3) adds a minor class-switched B-cell state signal. M4 (naive/quiescent lymphocyte program, 11.6%) is a diffuse shared naive or quiescent state rather than a T-cell signal, since core T markers are absent. Stress, IEG and NF-kB metagenes are small and not lineage-specific; no meaningful foreign-lineage contamination is evident.
cell_types: Naive B cells
metagene_label: Naive B cell markers + Naive lymphocyte quiescence program

label: Class-switched memory B cells, FCRL5-high
description: Cluster 7 is a B-lineage population: M53 (B cell add-on, FCRL5/IGHG3-high, cell_state) carries 31% of counts in nearly all cells, and M2 (naive B markers, IGHM/IGHD/FCER2/TCL1A/PAX5) adds 9.9% in about half the cells, with M50 (class-switched memory B, IGHA1/IGHG1/JCHAIN) at 3.8%. Top genes MS4A1, CD79A, CD72, FCRL5, FCRL3, CD22, BANK1 and IGHG3/IGHG1 confirm B identity with a memory/class-switched tilt. M0 (diffuse housekeeping background, 10.8%) and the remaining diffuse metagenes are low-specificity and not lineage-informative; the immediate-early/stress genes in M53 suggest some handling effect. No meaningful foreign lineage signal.
cell_types: B cells, Memory B cells, Naive B cells
metagene_label: B cell add-on, FCRL5/IGHG3-high + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background
refine_reason: Same identity as cluster 5 (class-switched memory B cells, M50 3.8%); the FCRL5/IGHG3 add-on program (M53 31%) is the qualifier, so the wording should match.

label: Classical monocytes, immediate early-high
description: Cluster 8 is a classical monocyte population. M1 (classical monocyte markers: S100A9, LYZ, S100A8, S100A12, VCAN, CD14) carries 25.7% of counts across 73% of cells at 18x enrichment, and the top genes (S100A9, LYZ, S100A8, VCAN, CD14, CSF3R, SPI1, KLF4) confirm the lineage. M5 (classical monocytes with immediate-early/stress genes FOS, JUNB, DUSP1) adds a stress-activated subset factor, and M46 (monocyte/macrophage) supports the myeloid identity. Smaller DC (M77, 4.4%) and inflammatory (M98, 1.9%) signals are minor and largely shared with monocytes; the rest is IEG/stress and diffuse background, with no meaningful foreign lineage.
cell_types: Classical monocytes, Monocytes
metagene_label: Classical monocyte markers + Classical monocytes, immediate early-high

label: Classical monocytes (+ some DC-like signal)
description: Cluster 9 is dominated by classical monocyte signal: M1 (classical monocyte markers, 31% of counts, present in 87% of cells, 11x enriched) with top genes S100A9, LYZ, S100A8, VCAN, CD14, and M46 (monocyte/macrophage program, 13%, 58% of cells, 12x enriched) with LYZ, CD14, CTSS, SPI1, MPEG1, CYBB, TYMP. Top genes confirm a myeloid monocyte identity. M77 (CLEC10A-high DC, 9%, 38% of cells) and M8 (FCGR3A/CDKN1C non-classical monocyte state, 3%) are minor monocyte-adjacent components; M77 shares LYZ/CST3 with monocytes and likely reflects some monocyte-DC mixing rather than a distinct DC population. Remaining metagenes (M0, M7, M15, M40, M28, M13) are diffuse housekeeping/stress background, and M57 is a weak interferon program, none of which alters the identity.
cell_types: Classical monocytes, CD14+ monocytes
metagene_label: Classical monocyte markers + Monocyte/macrophage markers

label: Dendritic cells (CLEC10A-high cDC2-like)
description: A small population dominated by M77 (40.9% of counts, in 99% of cells, 49x fold), with top genes CLEC10A (48.7x), CST3, CPVL, FCER1A-type DC markers, CD74 and CIITA, consistent with CLEC10A-high cDC2-like dendritic cells. Monocyte-like genes (LYZ, FGL2, SPI1, MS4A6A) suggest some monocyte-DC mixing, but the classical monocyte metagene M1 is only 2.8% of counts here, so this is not a substantial contamination. The diffuse M0 and M11 backgrounds lack lineage identity. CD1C is weak, so the cDC2 call is only moderately supported.
cell_types: Dendritic cells, cDC2, Monocyte-derived dendritic cells
metagene_label: Dendritic cells, CLEC10A-high + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Classical monocytes (inflammatory activated)
description: Cluster 11 is a classical monocyte population with a strong acute inflammatory and immediate-early activation state. M1 (classical monocyte markers: S100A9, LYZ, S100A8, VCAN, CD14) carries 21.9% of counts, and M46 (LYZ, CD14, CTSS, SPI1) and M5 (CD14, VCAN, KLF4, CSF3R) add to the monocyte identity. M98 is the largest signal at 17.7% in 90.7% of cells, with cytokines and NF-kB genes (CXCL8, IL1B, NFKBIA, TNF, CCL3, G0S2), consistent with ex vivo or dissociation-activated monocytes. Minor dendritic-cell (M77, 3.6%) and IEG program signals are background-level and are not treated as contamination.
cell_types: Classical monocytes, Myeloid cells
metagene_label: Classical monocyte markers + Activated myeloid inflammatory response

label: Non-classical monocytes (FCGR3A-high)
description: Cluster 12 is dominated by M8 (43.8% of counts, present in all cells, >100x enrichment), a CD16+ non-classical monocyte signature. Top genes CSF1R, MS4A7, FCGR3A, LST1, LILRB2, AIF1 and SPI1 confirm a myeloid lineage with a non-classical bias. Classical monocyte signal (M46, M5) is modest, so the cluster leans toward the FCGR3A-high subset. Diffuse background (M7, M0, M38, M28) and a small DC signal (M77) are present but weak, and no meaningful foreign lineage contamination is evident.
cell_types: Non-classical monocytes, Monocytes
metagene_label: Non-classical monocytes (FCGR3A/CDKN1C) + ACTB/VIM/TMSB4X-high

label: CD4 T cells (naive/central memory-like)
description: Cluster 13 is a large (11% of cells) CD4-leaning T-cell cluster. The identity rests on T-lineage metagenes M14 (CD4 T cell markers, 7.5% share, 13.5x enriched), M59 (T cell markers), M30 (CCR4+ CD4 memory-like, 6.3x) and M79 (naive CD4, 3.5x), with top genes IL7R, LTB, TRAC, CD5, CD28, CCR4, CD4, GATA3 supporting CD4 helper T cells of a naive/central-memory-like profile. Large diffuse background factors M0 and M20 (about 10% combined) carry no lineage and do not change the call; there is no clear foreign lineage signal.
cell_types: CD4 T cells, Naive CD4 T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + CD4 T cell markers

label: CD4 T cells (memory-like)
description: A T-cell cluster leaning CD4 helper, with memory-like features. M14 (CD4 T markers, 7.1%) and M86 (CD4 CTLA4/CD28 state) are enriched, and top genes IL7R, IL32, CD5, CD6, MAF, GATA3 and CD40LG support this. M10 (generic T markers) and M59 (T-cell markers) add general T-cell identity. M29 (MAIT-like, KLRB1, RORC-like genes) is a minor innate-like subset, not the main identity. M0 and other diffuse factors are background, and no clear foreign lineage contamination is present.
cell_types: CD4 T cells, MAIT-like T cells, CD8 T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + CD4 T cell markers

label: CD8 effector memory T cells (mixed CD4 T signal)
description: Cluster 15 is a T-cell cluster. Pan-T signals (M61 pan-T markers, M59 T-cell markers, M56 naive T markers, M30 CD4 memory) carry most of the lineage identity, and top genes TRBC2, TRBC1, CD28 and CTLA4 agree. The strongest subset signal is M48 (GZMK-high CD8 effector memory, fold 11.2, top genes CCL5 and GZMK), which leans the cluster toward CD8 memory-like cells, but it is present in only about 15% of cells. CD4 (M30, M86) and Treg (M39, in few cells) signals are also present, so the cluster is a mixed-subset T population. No substantial foreign lineage is seen. Diffuse background metagenes (M0, M11, M58, M45, M60, M37) add no identity.
cell_types: CD8 effector memory T cells, CD4 T cells, T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + GZMK-high CD8 effector memory T cells

label: Regulatory T cells (CD4 memory-like)
description: Cluster 16 is dominated by regulatory CD4+ T cell signal: M39 (Treg identity, FOXP3/IL2RA/CTLA4/TIGIT/IKZF2, fold 59.7x, in 55% of cells) carries the largest identifiable share, with top genes FOXP3, RTKN2, CTLA4, IL2RA and IKZF2 strongly enriched. Supporting CD4 helper/memory signal comes from M30 (CCR4, GATA3, MAF, CD28, fold 12.5x) and T-lineage metagenes M59, M19, M42 (TRAC, TRBC1/2, CD3 genes), with IL32 among top genes. Remaining metagenes (M0, M11, M7, M45, M60) are diffuse housekeeping or leukocyte background with no lineage. No clear foreign lineage contamination; the cluster is a Treg-leaning CD4 T population.
cell_types: Regulatory T cells, CD4 T cells
metagene_label: Regulatory T cells (FOXP3/IL2RA) + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Cytotoxic NK cells (CD56dim CD16-high)
description: Cluster 17 is dominated by M3, a cytotoxic lymphocyte program (GNLY, NKG7, PRF1, GZMB, FGFBP2, KLRF1, SH2D1B, FCGR3A, KLRD1) at 33% of counts and 20x enrichment, present in all cells. Top genes (GNLY, PRF1, NKG7, FGFBP2, SPON2, GZMB, KLRF1, KLRD1, FCGR3A) point to CD56dim/CD16-high cytotoxic NK cells, with some CD247/TRDC signal suggesting a minor NKT-like or CD8 effector component. The remaining metagenes (M0, M37, M90, M13, M35, M28, M92, M11) are diffuse, low-specificity housekeeping or leukocyte background with no lineage. M43 (PTGDS/FGFBP2/S100B) is a small, ambiguous add-on in about 3% of cells and not treated as contamination. M93 is a minor cycling signal in under 1% of cells.
cell_types: Cytotoxic NK cells, NKT-like cells, Cytotoxic CD8 T cells
metagene_label: Cytotoxic NK cell markers + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Cytotoxic NK cells (CD56dim)
description: Cluster 18 is dominated by cytotoxic lymphocyte programs: M3 (cytotoxic NK markers, GNLY, NKG7, PRF1, GZMB, FGFBP2, KLRF1; 23% of counts, present in 92% of cells, 6.8x enriched) and M34 (NK cell markers with IL2RB, CTSW, KLRD1; 8% share, 13.8x enriched) together with top genes GNLY, NKG7, PRF1, IL2RB, KLRD1, KLRF1, IL18RAP, pointing to a CD56dim cytotoxic NK cell identity, with some gamma-delta/NKT-like contribution (TRDC, CD247). M74 (CD8 effector program, 2%, 1.2% of cells) is a minor, sparse add-on not defining the cluster. Remaining metagenes (M0, M90, M37, M28, M38, M13) are diffuse housekeeping or lymphocyte-baseline background with no lineage signal and are not treated as contamination.
cell_types: Cytotoxic NK cells, NK cells, Gamma-delta T cells
metagene_label: Cytotoxic NK cell markers + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: NK cells (with some gamma-delta T-like signal)
description: Cluster 19 is dominated by M34 (30% of counts, present in 98% of cells, 51x enriched) carrying GNLY, NKG7, CTSW, KLRD1, KLRF1, NCAM1, KLRC1, IL2RB and IL18RAP, with top genes GNLY, IL2RB, TRDC, CTSW, KLRD1 and KLRC1 confirming an NK-cell identity. Some gamma-delta or CD8 T-like contribution (TRDC, CD7, CD2) is present, so this may be an NK-enriched population with a T-like component. M3 (cytotoxic NK markers) is weak here (fold 0.5x) and its peak is in cluster 17, so it is not a distinguishing factor. The large diffuse housekeeping factors (M0, M38, M60, M51, M13, M76, M96) carry no lineage signal and are background. No substantial foreign lineage is detected.
cell_types: NK cells, Gamma-delta T cells
metagene_label: NK cell markers + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Cytotoxic NK cells (CD8 effector T overlap)
description: Cluster 20 is dominated by a cytotoxic lymphocyte program: M3 (cytotoxic NK markers, GNLY, NKG7, PRF1, GZMB, FGFBP2, KLRF1; 16.4% share, 4.2x enriched, in 81% of cells) and M26 (cytotoxic effector T/NK, NKG7, GNLY, CCL5, GZMH, CD8A; 13.4% share, 7.9x enriched). Top genes (NKG7, GNLY, PRF1, CCL5, FGFBP2, GZMH, KLRD1, KLRF1-linked CX3CR1, SPON2) fit terminal-effector NK cells, with CD8 effector T cells (M74, CD8A/EOMES/KLRK1) as a minor component; CD3E is low-weight, favoring NK over T. Remaining metagenes (M0, M11, M37, M13, M28) are diffuse background with no lineage, and M43 and M89 are small, ambiguous or activation-like signals. No clear foreign lineage contamination.
cell_types: Cytotoxic NK cells, CD8 effector T cells
metagene_label: Cytotoxic NK cell markers + Cytotoxic effector T/NK cells

label: Cytotoxic CD8 effector T cells
description: Cluster of cytotoxic effector lymphocytes leaning toward CD8 T cells. M74 (CD8 cytotoxic effector program, fold 16.6x) and M26 (cytotoxic effector T/NK axis, fold 8.0x) carry the signal, with CD8A (5.7x), KLRG1, EOMES, NKG7, CTSW and CCL5 among the top enriched genes. M32 adds a modest T-cell lineage signal (CD2, CD3E, CD247, BCL11B). M3 (NK markers) is small and present in only about 9% of cells, so it is not a substantial NK population or contamination. M0, M11, M13 and M38 are diffuse background factors with no lineage content.
cell_types: CD8 T cells, NK cells
metagene_label: Cytotoxic effector T/NK cells + CD8 cytotoxic effector T cells

label: Cytotoxic CD8 effector T cells (NK-like overlap)
description: Cluster 22 is dominated by M26, a cytotoxic effector program (NKG7, GNLY, CCL5, PRF1, GZMH, CD8A, FGFBP2, CX3CR1) present in nearly all cells at 19.5% share and 16x enrichment, with M74 (CD8 cytotoxic effector T, NKG7/CTSW/CD8A/EOMES) and top genes GZMH, CD8A and KLRG1 supporting terminal effector CD8 T cells, with NK overlap likely. M0 diffuse housekeeping background (10%, not enriched) and many low-specificity diffuse metagenes (M11, M37, M76, M60, M13) are non-lineage background. M10 and M32 give a weak generic T-cell signal. No substantial foreign lineage is evident; M43 is minor and ambiguous.
cell_types: CD8 effector T cells, NK cells, Cytotoxic lymphocytes
metagene_label: Cytotoxic effector T/NK cells + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background
initial_label: CD8 cytotoxic effector T cells (NK-like overlap)
refine_reason: Same identity as cluster 21 ('Cytotoxic CD8 effector T cells'); wording aligned while keeping the NK-like overlap note.

label: GZMK-high CD8 effector memory T cells
description: Cluster 23 is dominated by CD8 T-cell signal: M74 (CD8 cytotoxic effector, NKG7, CTSW, CD8A, EOMES, 8.6x enriched) and M48 (GZMK-high CD8 effector memory, CCL5, GZMK, CD8A, GZMA, 20.5x enriched, in 13.6% of cells) together with M10 and M69 (naive/memory T markers). Top genes CCL5, GZMK, CD8A, KLRK1, EOMES, IL32 and TIGIT support CD8 effector-memory T cells. Diffuse factors M0, M23, M13 and M11 are background with no lineage, and M89 is an immediate-early activation program. M26 cytotoxic signal is shared with NK cells and is only modestly enriched, so NK contamination is possible but not clear.
cell_types: CD8 effector memory T cells, CD8 cytotoxic effector T cells, NK cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + CD8 cytotoxic effector T cells

label: Plasmacytoid dendritic cells
description: Cluster 24 is a plasmacytoid dendritic cell population. M16 (pDC markers) carries 56% of modeled counts and is present in essentially all cells, with pDC-specific genes CLEC4C, LILRA4, SERPINF1, PTPRS, IL3RA, PLD4, TCF4, JCHAIN and IRF7 among the top genes at >100x enrichment. Myeloid (CD1C, CLEC10A) and monocyte (LYZ, CD14) markers are absent, so there is no evident doublet or mixed signal. The remaining signal is diffuse background (M0, M47, M28, M65, M63), with a small CD34+ progenitor-like share (M85, 0.9%, in <0.1% of cells) that is too minor to change the call.
cell_types: Plasmacytoid dendritic cells
metagene_label: pDC markers + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Effector CD8 T and NK cells
description: Cluster 25 is a cytotoxic lymphocyte population. M26 (cytotoxic effector T/NK, 15.9% share, 9x enriched in 89% of cells) carries NKG7, GNLY, CCL5, GZMH, FGFBP2 and CD8A, and the top genes include CD8A (3.5x), CD2 and IL32. T-lineage support comes from M10 (T cell markers, 9.3x) and M32 (T cell markers with CD2, CD3E, CD6, BCL11B). The CD8 signal (CD8A, GZMH, FGFBP2) favors terminal effector CD8 T cells, but NK contribution cannot be excluded from the cytotoxic genes alone. M0 and the diffuse ACTB/ZAP70-type factors are low-specificity background, not contamination.
cell_types: Effector CD8 T cells, NK cells
metagene_label: Cytotoxic effector T/NK cells + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: MAIT-like T cells
description: Cluster 26 is dominated by an innate-like T cell program, M29 (12.9% of counts, in 58.7% of cells, 41.6x enriched), with MAIT-like genes RORC, SLC4A10, RORA, KLRB1, IL7R, CXCR6, NCR3 and CCR5 among the top modeled genes (KLRB1 11.7x, CCR5 10.8x). ZBTB16 and CCR6 carry little weight and TRAV1-2 is not measured, so the MAIT call is not fully confirmed. M48 (GZMK-high CD8 effector memory, 9.3x) and M26 (cytotoxic effector, 2.1x) add a CD8 effector-memory overlap, and M0, M13 and M28 are diffuse background with no lineage. No foreign lineage contamination is evident.
cell_types: MAIT cells, CD8 effector memory T cells, NK-like T cells
metagene_label: MAIT-like T cells + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Platelets/megakaryocytes
description: Cluster 27 (386 cells) is dominated by M31 (82% of modeled counts, present in all cells), with canonical platelet/megakaryocyte genes PPBP, PF4, TUBB1, ITGA2B, GP1BB, CAVIN2, GNG11 and MPIG6B at >100x fold over other cells, so the cluster is platelet/megakaryocyte-like. Other metagenes (M0, M25, M1, M85, M11, M7, M12, M8) each carry about 2% or less and are diffuse or minor lineage signals, not comparable identities, so they are background; M1 (classical monocyte) and M8 (non-classical monocyte) are small and not strong enough to call a mixture. Several platelet-adjacent genes (SPARC, CLU, F13A1, MYL9, TLN1) hint at a platelet/megakaryocyte identity rather than a separate lineage.
cell_types: Platelets, Megakaryocytes
metagene_label: Platelet/megakaryocyte genes + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: CD34+ hematopoietic progenitors (+ B cell signal)
description: Cluster 28 is dominated by a hematopoietic stem/progenitor signature. M85 carries 27.8% of counts and is present in 52% of cells at >100x fold, with top genes SOX4, SPINK2, MEX3B, HOXA9, MEIS1, GATA2, MYB, CD34 and NREP, and lineage markers largely absent. M50 adds 9.2% of counts in 26% of cells, mainly B-lineage genes (MS4A1, CD79A, IGHA1, IGHG1, JCHAIN) with a 9.7x enrichment, which is contamination or a B-cell-like subset rather than the cluster's own identity. The remaining metagenes (M0, M65, M47, M45, M15, M63) are diffuse housekeeping or stress backgrounds with no lineage signal.
cell_types: CD34+ hematopoietic progenitor cells
metagene_label: CD34+ progenitor cells + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background
